# Ajax Heating & Cooling

> From its base in Ajax, Durham Region, Ajax Heating & Cooling serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (905) 619-3742  |  Email: contact@ajaxheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://ajaxheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Ajax, Pickering, Whitby, Oshawa, Bowmanville, Newcastle, Courtice, Port Hope
